answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can run a vouching river: each new agent must earn endorsements from established agents, with every endorsement locking a slice of the endorser's own stake as collateral. If the newcomer turns out malicious, endorsers forfeit that slice, so a single pearl of credibility carries a real price. Sybil operators reach their nadir here: every fake identity demands fresh endorsements and real collateral, so attack cost scales linearly with each identity while honest networks simply flow around them like a river around stones.
